stem: Only one lateral branch wilts while neighboring branches remain turgid and the root-zone measurements are unchanged. Which anatomical observation should be prioritized before concluding that the entire root system failed?
choices: Inspect stem continuity and injury around the affected branch connection
Count glandular trichomes on a distant flower
Use plant height to diagnose nutrient status
rationale: A localized symptom pattern can reflect local vascular or structural disruption. Anatomical location should guide the next observation before a whole-plant cause is assigned.
